decisions.reason: As a newly launched extension of the firm's core coolant-management business, it fits the strategy for modular process-media solutions and is unlikely to be withdrawn so quickly.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens the established filtration and coolant-treatment offer, so a large engineering firm would usually keep it on the market while building references and service business.
A nozzle product line with several models broadens the installed-base offering and supports cross-selling, making a full withdrawal within a year unlikely.
Although somewhat less central because it is only close to the established offer, chip conveying is still strategically adjacent to the firm's material-flow portfolio and should be retained.
This conveyor variant builds directly on the firm's existing chip-handling business and matches customer demand for integrated production-support systems, so it is likely to stay.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is an adjacent but sensible addition to the broad portfolio, and a large German machinery supplier would typically keep such a recent launch unless results were clearly poor.
